sn35.85:1.1: Then the Venerable Ānanda approached the Blessed One … and said to him:
sn35.85:1.2: “Venerable sir, it is said, ‘Empty is the world, empty is the world.’
sn35.85:1.3: In what way, venerable sir, is it said, ‘Empty is the world’?”
sn35.85:1.4: “It is, Ānanda, because it is empty of self and of what belongs to self that it is said, ‘Empty is the world.’
sn35.85:1.5: And what is empty of self and of what belongs to self?
sn35.85:1.7: is empty of self and of what belongs to self. Forms are empty of self and of what belongs to self. Eye-consciousness is empty of self and of what belongs to self. Eye-contact is empty of self and of what belongs to self….
sn35.85:1.8: Whatever feeling arises with mind-contact as condition—whether pleasant or painful or neither-painful-nor-pleasant—that too is empty of self and of what belongs to self.
sn35.85:1.9: “It is, Ānanda, because it is empty of self and of what belongs to self that it is said, ‘Empty is the world.’”
